title: Build a Responsive Navigation with Hamburger Menu
description: Create a navigation bar that collapses into a hamburger menu on mobile and is horizontal on desktop.
problemStatement:
Create a responsive navigation bar using a mobile‑first approach. You'll write the HTML and CSS.

**HTML structure:**
- A `<header>` element containing:
  - A `<div class="logo">` with text "MySite".
  - A `<button class="menu-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="primary-menu">` with content `☰` (hamburger icon).
  - A `<nav id="primary-menu" class="nav-menu">` containing an unordered list with three links: Home, About, Contact.

**CSS requirements:**
- Apply universal box‑sizing reset.
- Base (mobile) styles:
  - `.logo` and `.menu-toggle` on the same line using flex: `display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;` on the header.
  - `.nav-menu` hidden by default (`display: none;`).
  - When the user toggles the menu (you'll simulate with a class `open`), `.nav-menu.open` should display block (or flex column).
  - Add styling: padding, background, link colours.
- Desktop styles (`min-width: 768px`):
  - Hide the `.menu-toggle` button (`display: none;`).
  - Show the `.nav-menu` by default (`display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 1rem;`).
  - Adjust header to use `flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between;`.
- No JavaScript needed; just write CSS that assumes a class `open` will be added to the nav via JS. But ensure the styles are ready.

Write the full HTML and CSS (internal style). Include the viewport meta tag as if it's a full page.
hints: For the mobile menu, you can style `.nav-menu` as `display: none;` and `.nav-menu.open` as `display: block;`.
Use `aria-expanded` on the button to communicate state. You don't need to update it dynamically for this task, just include it.
The hamburger icon entity `☰` renders as ☰.
expectedOutput: A responsive navigation that on mobile shows a hamburger button (and when `.open` is added to nav, the menu appears), and on desktop shows a horizontal menu without the button.
